summary: Assess project viability, model NPV and IRR, and compare commercial options. Build practical appraisal outputs in this five-day course.
lede: Feasibility and commercial evaluation helps project analysts, investment professionals and commercial teams judge whether proposals are viable and worth pursuing. It examines market, technical, operational and financial assumptions, including demand, delivery capacity, CAPEX and OPEX. Participants practise discounted cash-flow appraisal, Excel scenario and sensitivity testing, total-cost comparisons and risk assessment to explain trade-offs and prepare evidence-based recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review, develop, or approve investment proposals and need to substantiate feasibility, costs, commercial value, and risk.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with business proposals, project costs, or financial information is expected. Coding is not required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet exercises.
